name: social-export-4x5
summary: Crop to 4:5 portrait, size to 1080 x 1350, sharpen for screens, convert to sRGB.
when: Instagram feed portrait posts. Check the current platform spec before relying on the numbers.
photoshop: Crop tool (C) with ratio 4:5, Image > Image Size 1080 x 1350, Filter > Sharpen > Unsharp Mask, Edit > Convert to Profile sRGB
notes: Upscaling a small source (as in the test) softens it; the sharpen only hides part of that. Prefer a source at least 1080 px wide on the cropped side.
